notes.title: Mark Hamill To Host ‘Thunderful World’ Digital Showcase on November 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/892bc383a39eb0b46c5b4b09af85c4f9f1be9298.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

we have some awesome news, which we can finally share with you today: We - that's Thunderful Games - welcome all of you to the premiere of our very first digital games showcase ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’! ːsteamhappyː

Find out more in the following press release:


[i][b]Gothenburg, Sweden - October 28th, 2021[/b] - International developer and publisher Thunderful Games, creator of the multi-award winning and multi-million selling SteamWorld franchise, is welcoming everyone to a new digital games showcase, ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’. The event will be taking place on [b]November 10th at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET[/b], hosted by Hollywood and pop culture icon [b]Mark Hamill[/b]. Tune in to the livestream on Twitch, YouTube and the [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url] website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/8a01bc9ec10d1ba6e674354314fd34accd1fbb51.png[/img]

Tune in to see Mark delight us with a ton of exciting new game reveals and announcements from Thunderful. The event will deliver updates on exciting upcoming titles including the surprise indie hit of Summer Game Fest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608230/Planet_of_Lana/][b]Planet of Lana[/b][/url]. There will also be more news on Thunderful titles like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608550/Firegirl_Hack_n_Splash_Rescue/][b]Firegirl[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726120/Cursed_to_Golf/][b]Cursed to Golf[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315610/Source_of_Madness/][b]Source of Madness[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276660/Tinkertown/][b]Tinkertown[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158890/White_Shadows/][b]White Shadows[/b][/url]. 

Alongside Mark’s headline hosting role, the event will also feature appearances from Thunderful Group CEO Brjánn Sigurgeirsson, Corporate Vice President at Xbox Sarah Bond, plus a few other surprise industry partners.

Thunderful is proud to be partnering with Xbox and The MIX for Thunderful World. To sign up for the event and be the first to know all the important information ahead of the show on [b]November 10th[/b], head over to [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url]. As your one stop shop for all things Thunderful World, the website will be updated with new announcements and reveals as the event unfolds.[/i]


Stay tuned and tune in on Nov 10th - see you all in the event!
Your Thunderful Games-Team

notes.title: Win a complete set of Razer Chroma equipment!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38049169/0f53846e15bc6a11cb28899e5e059f5986cd7608.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

July 2021 is a very special month for us at [b]Headup[/b] and three of our developers as well! We released three games over the last weeks: [b]Lost At Sea[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543240/Gigapocalypse/][b]Gigapocalypse[/b][/url] and today [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390670/Escape_from_Naraka/][b]Escape from Naraka[/b][/url]. And all three games include [b]Razer Chroma[/b] support!

Why's that? Because [b]Chroma[/b] allows you to extend the atmosphere of the game beyond the screen through the mouse, keyboard, headset and mouse pad, which is a pretty cool thing! And if you own a Philips Hue set; if it's linked with [b]Chroma[/b], it illuminates the entire room in the colors of the game. Ingenious! ːsteamhappyː

Also, because we want you to dive deeper into our [b]Chroma[/b]-optimized games, we are giving away a complete set of [b]Razer Chroma[/b] equipment:

[url=https://gleam.io/QylI2/win-razer-chroma-equipment-escape-from-naraka-gigapocalypse-lost-at-sea][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38049169/7ebb42b0af941cd4fb32434fc7bc46120e6944fd.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]How to take part?[/b]
Just follow this link to our sweepstakes page on Gleam and follow the instructions: https://gleam.io/QylI2/win-razer-chroma-equipment-escape-from-naraka-gigapocalypse-lost-at-sea

Good luck everyone!
Studio Fizbin & Headup

notes.title: What are the most important moments in your life?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38049169/0b88aec8ebe91b701fde5737f9a8e40e3d9155a1.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

Can you compare the development of a game with life itself? Developing a game is complex - no question about it. But life is of course much more complex! But both are definitely an emotional roller coaster ride with a lot of ups and downs.

But it is worth it! And that's why we're really happy to announce that [b]Lost At Sea[/b] is available RIGHT NOW here on Steam! ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=UqEXdiqHgpw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Lost At Sea[/b] is something very special for us. Not only because many hours of work were invested in developing the game. It is a very emotional experience that is very close to our hearts. A story in which everyone can find themselves - and in which we find ourselves too.

[b]Let's say it with John Lennon:[/b]
[i]"Life is what happens to you while you’re busy making other plans."[/i]

The Lost At Sea Team

notes.title: Lost At Sea is setting sail on July 15th 2021 on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38049169/d2f91125420e629fcafabf0e4ea0826f87cfcd79.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

The [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is over and it was really a lot of fun! It was great to have all of you playing the demo and to receive feedback from you. Thank you very much for that - it is really appreciated! ❤️

[b]We have two good pieces of news for you today:[/b]
[olist][*] We decided not to deactivate the demo after the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], so that you guys out there have a bit more time to take a look what kind of game [b]Lost At Sea[/b] is.
[*] And - finally - we have a release date to share with all of you: [b]Lost at Sea[/b] will release on [u][b]July 15th 2021[/b][/u] here on Steam![/olist]
So, mark the date to set sail on time. See you all on the island without a name!
The Lost At Sea Team

notes.title: Join our Lost At Sea Steam Next Fest Stream this Thursday 8am PST/5pm CEST!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38049169/d4aa194d298ff0b784b16cdb6c46ba858044553f.jpg[/img]

Hey friends!

It's this time of the year again: It's time for the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! What does this mean for you peeps out there? Six days with hundreds of demos and an endless number of livestreams. Can there be anything better? ːsteamhappyː

Since we are participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] with our demo, we will be streaming [b]Lost At Sea[/b] for you as well. Come and join us and our publisher [b]Headup[/b] streaming [u][b]this Thursday, June 17th at 8am PST/5pm CEST[/b][/u].

We will show you some fresh gameplay out of [b]Lost At Sea[/b], which you can also try yourself with the demo! Join us all to learn more about the people that made the game, [b]Lost At Sea[/b] itself and the idea of the game. Save the date and tune in to learn more about our upcoming narrative first-person experience!

Btw. there are a bunch of additional games of our publisher [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Headup/][u][b]Headup[/b][/u][/url] participating in the Steam Next Fest! You shouldn't miss the demos and streams either: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172650/INDUSTRIA/][b]Industria[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158890/White_Shadows/][b]White Shadows[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390670/Escape_from_Naraka/][b]Escape from Naraka[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543240/Gigapocalypse/][b]Gigapocalypse[/b][/url]. Check them out!

See you all on the island without name!
The Lost At Sea Team
